ko.title: 13.1%와 16년 만의 최고치: 신용카드 연체율 상승이 시사하는 가계의 어려움

segments.src: ## A Warning Light on the Household Dashboard
segments.tr: ## 가계 경제의 경고등

segments.src: A single statistic tends to cut through the noise of economic data releases, and this quarter it's this one: the share of credit card balances that are seriously delinquent — payments overdue by 90 days or more — has climbed to roughly 13.1%, the highest level recorded since the aftermath of the Great Recession.
segments.tr: 경제 데이터 발표의 소음 속에서 유독 눈에 띄는 통계가 하나 있는데, 이번 분기에는 바로 이것입니다. 90일 이상 연체된 심각한 신용카드 잔액 비율이 약 13.1%까지 치솟았으며, 이는 대침체(Great Recession) 이후 기록된 가장 높은 수준입니다.

segments.src: For a metric that spent much of the 2010s trending quietly downward, a jump like this is hard to wave away as statistical noise.
segments.tr: 2010년대 내내 조용히 하향 곡선을 그리던 지표가 이처럼 급등한 것을 단순히 통계적 노이즈로 치부하기는 어렵습니다.

segments.src: Delinquency data doesn't grab headlines the way a jobs report or an inflation print does, but economists watch it closely for a reason.
segments.tr: 연체 데이터는 고용 보고서나 물가 지표처럼 헤드라인을 장식하지는 않지만, 경제학자들이 이를 면밀히 주시하는 데는 이유가 있습니다.

segments.src: Credit cards are typically the last bill a household stops paying, after the mortgage, the car loan, and utilities.
segments.tr: 신용카드는 일반적으로 가계가 주택 담보 대출, 자동차 대출, 공과금 다음으로 마지막까지 납부를 유지하는 청구서입니다.

segments.src: When delinquencies rise here first and fastest, it's often a sign that the cushion beneath consumer spending is thinning out.
segments.tr: 이 부문에서 연체율이 가장 먼저, 그리고 가장 빠르게 상승한다면, 이는 소비 지출을 뒷받침하던 완충 장치가 얇아지고 있다는 신호인 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## From Savings Cushion to Credit Dependence
segments.tr: ## 저축의 완충 지대에서 신용 의존으로

segments.src: During the pandemic years, stimulus payments, enhanced unemployment benefits, and reduced spending on travel and dining left many households with unusually large savings buffers.
segments.tr: 팬데믹 기간 동안 정부 지원금, 실업 급여 확대, 여행 및 외식 지출 감소로 인해 많은 가계가 평소보다 큰 저축 여력을 갖게 되었습니다.

segments.src: That excess savings pile acted as a shock absorber, letting families ride out early bouts of inflation without leaning too hard on credit.
segments.tr: 그 초과 저축액은 충격 흡수 장치 역할을 하여, 가족들이 신용에 과도하게 의존하지 않고도 초기 인플레이션의 파고를 넘길 수 있게 해주었습니다.

segments.src: That cushion has now largely been spent down.
segments.tr: 이제 그 완충 지대는 대부분 소진되었습니다.

segments.src: As it shrinks, more everyday costs — groceries, utility bills, insurance premiums, childcare — are increasingly being financed on revolving credit rather than paid for out of cash flow.
segments.tr: 완충 지대가 줄어들면서 식료품, 공과금, 보험료, 보육비 등 일상적인 비용들이 현금 흐름으로 지불되기보다는 회전 신용(revolving credit)으로 조달되는 경우가 점점 늘고 있습니다.

segments.src: That shift shows up doubly in the data: total credit card balances have kept climbing to record highs even as interest rates on that debt remain elevated, meaning households are borrowing more at the exact moment borrowing has become more expensive.
segments.tr: 이러한 변화는 데이터에서 이중으로 나타납니다. 총 신용카드 잔액은 부채에 대한 이자율이 여전히 높은 상황에서도 계속해서 사상 최고치를 경신하고 있으며, 이는 가계가 대출 비용이 가장 비싸진 바로 그 시점에 더 많은 대출을 받고 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: ## Who Is Feeling the Squeeze Most
segments.tr: ## 가장 큰 타격을 받는 계층

segments.src: The pain isn't distributed evenly.
segments.tr: 고통이 고르게 분배되는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Delinquency increases have been concentrated among younger borrowers and lower-income households, groups with thinner savings and less flexibility to absorb price shocks in the first place.
segments.tr: 연체율 증가는 저축액이 적고 가격 충격을 흡수할 여력이 부족한 젊은 차주와 저소득 가계에 집중되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Auto loans and, to a lesser extent, personal loans have shown similar stress, suggesting this isn't a phenomenon isolated to plastic — it's a broader story about stretched household budgets.
segments.tr: 자동차 대출과 정도는 덜하지만 개인 대출에서도 유사한 스트레스가 나타나고 있는데, 이는 신용카드만의 문제가 아니라 가계 예산 전반이 한계에 다다랐음을 보여주는 더 큰 이야기입니다.

segments.src: At the same time, it's worth resisting the temptation to read a single indicator as proof of an imminent crisis.
segments.tr: 동시에, 단 하나의 지표를 임박한 위기의 증거로 해석하려는 유혹은 경계할 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: Aggregate household debt as a share of income remains far below the levels seen just before 2008, and the labor market, while cooling, has not deteriorated sharply.
segments.tr: 소득 대비 총 가계 부채 비율은 2008년 직전 수준보다 훨씬 낮으며, 노동 시장도 냉각되고는 있지만 급격하게 악화되지는 않았습니다.

segments.src: What the delinquency data suggests is less a repeat of the financial crisis and more a signal that the post-pandemic buffer many families relied on has run its course.
segments.tr: 연체 데이터가 시사하는 바는 금융 위기의 재현이라기보다는, 많은 가계가 의존해 온 팬데믹 이후의 완충 장치가 한계에 다다랐다는 신호에 더 가깝습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Lenders and Policymakers Are Watching Closely
segments.tr: ## 대출 기관과 정책 입안자들이 면밀히 주시하는 이유

segments.src: For banks and card issuers, rising delinquencies typically translate into higher loss provisions, which can lead to tighter underwriting standards down the road — fewer pre-approved offers, lower credit limits, and stricter income verification for new applicants.
segments.tr: 은행과 카드사 입장에서 연체율 상승은 일반적으로 대손충당금 증가로 이어지며, 이는 향후 대출 심사 기준 강화(사전 승인 제안 감소, 신용 한도 축소, 신규 신청자에 대한 엄격한 소득 증빙 요구 등)로 이어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That tightening, in turn, can make it harder for exactly the borrowers who are struggling to access the short-term credit they might need.
segments.tr: 이러한 긴축은 결과적으로 당장 어려움을 겪고 있어 단기 신용이 절실한 차주들이 자금을 조달하기 더 어렵게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For the Federal Reserve and other policymakers, consumer credit health is one more data point in the broader debate about how long borrowing costs should stay elevated.
segments.tr: 연방준비제도(Fed)와 기타 정책 입안자들에게 소비자 신용 건전성은 차입 비용을 얼마나 오랫동안 높게 유지해야 하는지에 대한 더 넓은 논쟁에서 하나의 데이터 포인트가 됩니다.

segments.src: A steady rise in serious delinquency rates adds weight to the argument that current rate levels are squeezing households more than aggregate spending figures alone might suggest, even as those same spending figures have kept the broader economy looking resilient on the surface.
segments.tr: 심각한 연체율의 꾸준한 상승은 현재의 금리 수준이 총 지출 수치만으로 예상되는 것보다 가계에 더 큰 압박을 가하고 있다는 주장에 힘을 실어줍니다. 비록 그 지출 수치들이 표면적으로는 광범위한 경제가 회복력을 유지하고 있는 것처럼 보이게 할지라도 말입니다.

segments.src: ## What Households Can Take From This
segments.tr: ## 가계가 얻을 수 있는 교훈

segments.src: For individual consumers, the practical takeaway is less about the headline number and more about the trend line underneath it.
segments.tr: 개별 소비자에게 실질적인 시사점은 헤드라인 수치보다는 그 이면의 추세선에 있습니다.

segments.src: A few points worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: 기억해야 할 몇 가지 포인트는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Revolving balances compound quickly.** With average card interest rates still sitting well into the double digits, carrying a balance month to month is one of the most expensive ways to bridge a budget shortfall.
segments.tr: - **회전 잔액은 빠르게 복리로 불어납니다.** 평균 카드 이자율이 여전히 두 자릿수대를 유지하고 있는 상황에서, 매달 잔액을 이월하는 것은 예산 부족을 메우는 가장 비싼 방법 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: - **Minimum payments are a trap, not a plan.** Paying only the minimum can stretch a manageable balance into years of interest charges.
segments.tr: - **최소 결제 금액은 계획이 아니라 함정입니다.** 최소 금액만 납부하면 관리 가능한 수준의 잔액도 수년간의 이자 비용으로 늘어날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Early conversations with lenders help.** Card issuers often have hardship programs, temporary rate reductions, or modified payment plans available — but usually only for customers who reach out before an account goes seriously delinquent.
segments.tr: - **대출 기관과의 조기 상담이 도움이 됩니다.** 카드사는 종종 채무 조정 프로그램, 일시적인 금리 인하, 또는 수정된 상환 계획을 제공하지만, 이는 대개 계좌가 심각하게 연체되기 전에 먼저 연락하는 고객에게만 해당됩니다.

segments.src: - **Rebuilding a buffer matters more than ever.** Even a small emergency fund can prevent a single unexpected expense from turning into a new credit card balance that lingers for months.
segments.tr: - **완충 자금을 재건하는 것이 그 어느 때보다 중요합니다.** 작은 비상금이라도 있으면 예상치 못한 단 한 번의 지출이 몇 달 동안 지속되는 새로운 신용카드 잔액으로 변하는 것을 막을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: Delinquency statistics are backward-looking by nature — they describe bills that are already overdue rather than predicting what comes next.
segments.tr: 연체 통계는 본질적으로 후행 지표입니다. 즉, 앞으로 일어날 일을 예측하기보다는 이미 연체된 청구서를 설명합니다.

segments.src: But as a leading indicator of household financial stress, a 16-year high is not a number to shrug off.
segments.tr: 하지만 가계 재정 스트레스의 선행 지표로서 16년 만의 최고치는 가볍게 넘길 수 있는 숫자가 아닙니다.

segments.src: It suggests that beneath a labor market and stock market that have generally held up, a meaningful slice of American households is quietly falling behind, one credit card statement at a time.
segments.tr: 이는 전반적으로 견고함을 유지해 온 노동 시장과 주식 시장 이면에서, 상당수의 미국 가계가 신용카드 명세서 하나하나에 밀려 조용히 뒤처지고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: Whether this marks a temporary adjustment as pandemic-era savings normalize, or the early stage of a more persistent affordability crunch, will likely depend on what happens next with inflation, interest rates, and hiring.
segments.tr: 이것이 팬데믹 시대의 저축이 정상화되면서 나타나는 일시적인 조정인지, 아니면 더 지속적인 구매력 위기의 초기 단계인지는 향후 인플레이션, 금리, 고용 상황에 따라 달라질 것입니다.

segments.src: Until then, the delinquency rate is one of the clearest windows available into how ordinary families are actually managing — or struggling to manage — their monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 그때까지 연체율은 평범한 가정들이 월 예산을 어떻게 관리하고 있는지, 혹은 관리하기 위해 얼마나 고군분투하고 있는지를 보여주는 가장 명확한 창 중 하나가 될 것입니다.

zh.title: 13.1% 与 16 年新高：信用卡严重逾期率上升揭示了家庭财务的何种困境

segments.src: ## A Warning Light on the Household Dashboard
segments.tr: ## 家庭财务仪表盘上的警示灯

segments.src: A single statistic tends to cut through the noise of economic data releases, and this quarter it's this one: the share of credit card balances that are seriously delinquent — payments overdue by 90 days or more — has climbed to roughly 13.1%, the highest level recorded since the aftermath of the Great Recession.
segments.tr: 在繁杂的经济数据发布中，往往有一个统计数据能够穿透噪音，而本季度正是这一个：严重逾期（逾期 90 天或以上）的信用卡余额比例已攀升至约 13.1%，这是自大衰退结束以来的最高水平。

segments.src: For a metric that spent much of the 2010s trending quietly downward, a jump like this is hard to wave away as statistical noise.
segments.tr: 对于一个在 2010 年代大部分时间里都在悄无声息地下滑的指标来说，如此大幅度的跳升很难简单地归咎于统计噪音。

segments.src: Delinquency data doesn't grab headlines the way a jobs report or an inflation print does, but economists watch it closely for a reason.
segments.tr: 逾期数据不像就业报告或通胀数据那样容易占据头条新闻，但经济学家密切关注它是有原因的。

segments.src: Credit cards are typically the last bill a household stops paying, after the mortgage, the car loan, and utilities.
segments.tr: 信用卡通常是家庭在断供房贷、车贷和公用事业费之后，最后停止支付的账单。

segments.src: When delinquencies rise here first and fastest, it's often a sign that the cushion beneath consumer spending is thinning out.
segments.tr: 当这里的逾期率先开始且上升最快时，往往意味着支撑消费者支出的缓冲垫正在变薄。

segments.src: ## From Savings Cushion to Credit Dependence
segments.tr: ## 从储蓄缓冲到信用依赖

segments.src: During the pandemic years, stimulus payments, enhanced unemployment benefits, and reduced spending on travel and dining left many households with unusually large savings buffers.
segments.tr: 在疫情期间，刺激计划接济金、定额失业救济金的提高以及在旅游和餐饮上支出的减少，使许多家庭拥有了不同寻常的丰厚储蓄缓冲。

segments.src: That excess savings pile acted as a shock absorber, letting families ride out early bouts of inflation without leaning too hard on credit.
segments.tr: 这笔超额储蓄充当了减震器的角色，让家庭能够在不过度依赖信贷的情况下度过早期的通货膨胀。

segments.src: That cushion has now largely been spent down.
segments.tr: 如今，这层缓冲垫已基本被消耗殆尽。

segments.src: As it shrinks, more everyday costs — groceries, utility bills, insurance premiums, childcare — are increasingly being financed on revolving credit rather than paid for out of cash flow.
segments.tr: 随着它的缩减，越来越多的日常开支——杂货、公用事业账单、保险费、托儿费——正日益通过循环信贷来融资，而不是由现金流支付。

segments.src: That shift shows up doubly in the data: total credit card balances have kept climbing to record highs even as interest rates on that debt remain elevated, meaning households are borrowing more at the exact moment borrowing has become more expensive.
segments.tr: 这种转变在数据中得到了双重体现：即使债务利率维持在高位，信用卡余额总量仍不断创下历史新高，这意味着家庭恰恰在借贷成本变得更加昂贵的时刻借了更多的钱。

segments.src: ## Who Is Feeling the Squeeze Most
segments.tr: ## 谁感受到的挤压最为严重

segments.src: The pain isn't distributed evenly.
segments.tr: 这种痛苦并非均匀分布的。

segments.src: Delinquency increases have been concentrated among younger borrowers and lower-income households, groups with thinner savings and less flexibility to absorb price shocks in the first place.
segments.tr: 逾期率的上升主要集中在年轻借款人和低收入家庭中，这些群体本身储蓄较少，吸收价格冲击的灵活性也较差。

segments.src: Auto loans and, to a lesser extent, personal loans have shown similar stress, suggesting this isn't a phenomenon isolated to plastic — it's a broader story about stretched household budgets.
segments.tr: 汽车贷款以及程度稍轻的个人贷款也表现出了类似的压力，这表明这并非局限于信用卡领域的孤立现象——而是一个关于家庭预算拉紧的更广泛故事。

segments.src: At the same time, it's worth resisting the temptation to read a single indicator as proof of an imminent crisis.
segments.tr: 与此同时，也应当避免将单一指标视为即将来临的危机的证据。

segments.src: Aggregate household debt as a share of income remains far below the levels seen just before 2008, and the labor market, while cooling, has not deteriorated sharply.
segments.tr: 家庭总债务占收入的比重仍远低于 2008 年之前的水平，而劳动力市场虽然在降温，但并未急剧恶化。

segments.src: What the delinquency data suggests is less a repeat of the financial crisis and more a signal that the post-pandemic buffer many families relied on has run its course.
segments.tr: 逾期数据所提示的，与其说是金融危机的重演，不如说是一个信号，表明许多家庭所依赖的后疫情时代缓冲期已经结束。

segments.src: ## Why Lenders and Policymakers Are Watching Closely
segments.tr: ## 为什么贷款机构和政策制定者在密切关注

segments.src: For banks and card issuers, rising delinquencies typically translate into higher loss provisions, which can lead to tighter underwriting standards down the road — fewer pre-approved offers, lower credit limits, and stricter income verification for new applicants.
segments.tr: 对于银行和发卡机构而言，逾期率上升通常意味着更高的坏账准备金，这可能导致日后采取更严格的核贷标准——减少预先批准的额度、降低信用额度以及对新申请人进行更严格的收入核实。

segments.src: That tightening, in turn, can make it harder for exactly the borrowers who are struggling to access the short-term credit they might need.
segments.tr: 反过来，这种紧缩可能会让那些恰恰陷入困境的借款人更难获得他们可能需要的短期信贷。

segments.src: For the Federal Reserve and other policymakers, consumer credit health is one more data point in the broader debate about how long borrowing costs should stay elevated.
segments.tr: 对于美联储和其他政策制定者来说，消费者信贷健康状况是关于借贷成本应维持高位多久的更广泛讨论中的又一个数据点。

segments.src: A steady rise in serious delinquency rates adds weight to the argument that current rate levels are squeezing households more than aggregate spending figures alone might suggest, even as those same spending figures have kept the broader economy looking resilient on the surface.
segments.tr: 严重逾期率的持续上升增加了这一观点的分量：当前的利率水平对家庭的挤压比仅凭总支出数据所显示的要大，尽管正是这些支出数据让整体经济在表面上看起来富有韧性。

segments.src: ## What Households Can Take From This
segments.tr: ## 家庭可以从中汲取什么

segments.src: For individual consumers, the practical takeaway is less about the headline number and more about the trend line underneath it.
segments.tr: 对于普通消费者来说，实际的启示与其说是头条新闻中的数字，不如说是其背后的趋势线。

segments.src: A few points worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: 以下几点值得牢记：

segments.src: - **Revolving balances compound quickly.** With average card interest rates still sitting well into the double digits, carrying a balance month to month is one of the most expensive ways to bridge a budget shortfall.
segments.tr: - **循环余额累积迅速。** 在信用卡平均利率仍高达两位数的情况下，逐月拖欠余额是弥补预算赤字成本最高昂的方式之一。

segments.src: - **Minimum payments are a trap, not a plan.** Paying only the minimum can stretch a manageable balance into years of interest charges.
segments.tr: - **最低还款额是陷阱，而不是计划。** 仅支付最低还款额可能会将可控的余额演变成长达数年的利息支出。

segments.src: - **Early conversations with lenders help.** Card issuers often have hardship programs, temporary rate reductions, or modified payment plans available — but usually only for customers who reach out before an account goes seriously delinquent.
segments.tr: - **尽早与贷款机构沟通有所帮助。** 发卡机构通常提供困境补助计划、临时降息或修改后的还款计划——但通常仅适用于在账户严重逾期之前就主动联系的客户。

segments.src: - **Rebuilding a buffer matters more than ever.** Even a small emergency fund can prevent a single unexpected expense from turning into a new credit card balance that lingers for months.
segments.tr: - **重建缓冲垫比以往任何时候都重要。** 即使是一笔微小的应急基金，也能防止一次意外支出变成拖延数月的信用卡新账单。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更宏观的图景

segments.src: Delinquency statistics are backward-looking by nature — they describe bills that are already overdue rather than predicting what comes next.
segments.tr: 逾期统计数据本质上是后视性的——它们描述的是已经逾期的账单，而不是预测下一步会发生什么。

segments.src: But as a leading indicator of household financial stress, a 16-year high is not a number to shrug off.
segments.tr: 但作为家庭财务压力的一项先行指标，创 16 年新高并非一个可以耸耸肩置之不理的数字。

segments.src: It suggests that beneath a labor market and stock market that have generally held up, a meaningful slice of American households is quietly falling behind, one credit card statement at a time.
segments.tr: 它表明，在总体上保持稳定的劳动力市场和股票市场之下，很大一部分美国家庭正在默默地落后，一次一张信用卡账单。

segments.src: Whether this marks a temporary adjustment as pandemic-era savings normalize, or the early stage of a more persistent affordability crunch, will likely depend on what happens next with inflation, interest rates, and hiring.
segments.tr: 这究竟标志着疫情时代储蓄正常化过程中的暂态调整，还是更持久的负担能力危机早期阶段，可能取决于通胀、利率和招聘接下来的走势。

segments.src: Until then, the delinquency rate is one of the clearest windows available into how ordinary families are actually managing — or struggling to manage — their monthly budgets.
segments.tr: 在此之前，逾期率依然是了解普通家庭如何实际管理——或艰难管理——其每月预算的最清晰窗口之一。

hi.title: 13.1% और 16 साल का उच्चतम स्तर: क्रेडिट कार्ड की बढ़ती चूक से परिवारों पर दबाव का खुलासा

segments.src: ## A Warning Light on the Household Dashboard
segments.tr: ## घरेलू डैशबोर्ड पर एक चेतावनी लाइट

segments.src: A single statistic tends to cut through the noise of economic data releases, and this quarter it's this one: the share of credit card balances that are seriously delinquent — payments overdue by 90 days or more — has climbed to roughly 13.1%, the highest level recorded since the aftermath of the Great Recession.
segments.tr: एक अकेला आंकड़ा आर्थिक डेटा जारी होने के शोर को दूर करने में मदद करता है, और इस तिमाही का आंकड़ा यह है: गंभीर रूप से डिफ़ॉल्ट (चूक वाले) क्रेडिट कार्ड शेष राशि का हिस्सा — यानी वे भुगतान जो 90 दिनों या उससे अधिक समय से अतिदेय (overdue) हैं — बढ़कर लगभग 13.1% हो गया है, जो कि महामंदी के बाद से दर्ज किया गया उच्चतम स्तर है।

segments.src: For a metric that spent much of the 2010s trending quietly downward, a jump like this is hard to wave away as statistical noise.
segments.tr: एक ऐसे मीट्रिक के लिए, जिसने 2010 के दशक का अधिकांश समय धीरे-धीरे नीचे की ओर रुझान में बिताया, इस तरह की छलांग को सांख्यिकीय शोर कहकर खारिज करना मुश्किल है।

segments.src: Delinquency data doesn't grab headlines the way a jobs report or an inflation print does, but economists watch it closely for a reason.
segments.tr: डिफ़ॉल्ट डेटा उस तरह से सुर्खियों में नहीं आता जिस तरह से जॉब रिपोर्ट या मुद्रास्फीति का आंकड़ा आता है, लेकिन अर्थशास्त्री एक कारण से इस पर बारीकी से नज़र रखते हैं।

segments.src: Credit cards are typically the last bill a household stops paying, after the mortgage, the car loan, and utilities.
segments.tr: क्रेडिट कार्ड आमतौर पर अंतिम बिल होते हैं जिनका भुगतान एक परिवार बंद करता है — मॉर्गेज, कार लोन और उपयोगिता (utilities) बिलों के बाद।

segments.src: When delinquencies rise here first and fastest, it's often a sign that the cushion beneath consumer spending is thinning out.
segments.tr: जब यहां डिफ़ॉल्ट सबसे पहले और सबसे तेजी से बढ़ता है, तो यह अक्सर इस बात का संकेत होता है कि उपभोक्ता खर्च के नीचे का बफर कम हो रहा है।

segments.src: ## From Savings Cushion to Credit Dependence
segments.tr: ## बचत बफर से क्रेडिट निर्भरता तक

segments.src: During the pandemic years, stimulus payments, enhanced unemployment benefits, and reduced spending on travel and dining left many households with unusually large savings buffers.
segments.tr: महामारी के वर्षों के दौरान, प्रोत्साहन भुगतानों (stimulus payments), बढ़ी हुई बेरोजगारी लाभों और यात्रा तथा खान-पान पर कम खर्च के कारण कई परिवारों के पास असामान्य रूप से बड़ा बचत बफर बच गया था।

segments.src: That excess savings pile acted as a shock absorber, letting families ride out early bouts of inflation without leaning too hard on credit.
segments.tr: अतिरिक्त बचत के उस ढेर ने एक शॉक एब्जॉर्बर के रूप में काम किया, जिससे परिवारों को क्रेडिट पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर हुए बिना मुद्रास्फीति के शुरुआती झटकों का सामना करने में मदद मिली।

segments.src: That cushion has now largely been spent down.
segments.tr: वह बफर अब काफी हद तक खत्म हो चुका है।

segments.src: As it shrinks, more everyday costs — groceries, utility bills, insurance premiums, childcare — are increasingly being financed on revolving credit rather than paid for out of cash flow.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे यह कम हो रहा है, अधिक रोजमर्रा के खर्चों — जैसे कि किराने का सामान, उपयोगिता बिल, बीमा प्रीमियम, बच्चों की देखभाल — का वित्तपोषण नकदी प्रवाह से करने के बजाय रिवॉल्विंग क्रेडिट पर अधिक से अधिक किया जा रहा है।

segments.src: That shift shows up doubly in the data: total credit card balances have kept climbing to record highs even as interest rates on that debt remain elevated, meaning households are borrowing more at the exact moment borrowing has become more expensive.
segments.tr: यह बदलाव आंकड़ों में दोगुना दिखाई देता है: कुल क्रेडिट कार्ड का बकाया रिकॉर्ड ऊंचाई पर पहुंचना जारी है, भले ही उस कर्ज पर ब्याज दरें ऊंची बनी हुई हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि परिवार ठीक उसी समय अधिक उधार ले रहे हैं जब उधार लेना अधिक महंगा हो गया है।

segments.src: ## Who Is Feeling the Squeeze Most
segments.tr: ## किसे सबसे अधिक दबाव महसूस हो रहा है

segments.src: The pain isn't distributed evenly.
segments.tr: यह दर्द समान रूप से वितरित नहीं है।

segments.src: Delinquency increases have been concentrated among younger borrowers and lower-income households, groups with thinner savings and less flexibility to absorb price shocks in the first place.
segments.tr: डिफ़ॉल्ट में वृद्धि मुख्य रूप से कम उम्र के उधारकर्ताओं और कम आय वाले परिवारों के बीच केंद्रित रही है — ये ऐसे समूह हैं जिनके पास कम बचत है और पहली बार में कीमतों के झटकों को झेलने की कम लचीलापन है।

segments.src: Auto loans and, to a lesser extent, personal loans have shown similar stress, suggesting this isn't a phenomenon isolated to plastic — it's a broader story about stretched household budgets.
segments.tr: ऑटो लोन और, कुछ हद तक, व्यक्तिगत ऋणों ने भी इसी तरह का तनाव दिखाया है, जो यह दर्शाता है कि यह घटना केवल प्लास्टिक कार्ड तक सीमित नहीं है — यह तंग घरेलू बजट की एक व्यापक कहानी है।

segments.src: At the same time, it's worth resisting the temptation to read a single indicator as proof of an imminent crisis.
segments.tr: साथ ही, किसी एक संकेतक को आसन्न संकट के प्रमाण के रूप में देखने के प्रलोभन से बचना भी उचित है।

segments.src: Aggregate household debt as a share of income remains far below the levels seen just before 2008, and the labor market, while cooling, has not deteriorated sharply.
segments.tr: आय के हिस्से के रूप में कुल घरेलू ऋण 2008 से ठीक पहले देखे गए स्तरों से काफी नीचे बना हुआ है, और श्रम बाजार, हालांकि ठंडा हो रहा है, तेजी से नहीं बिगड़ा है।

segments.src: What the delinquency data suggests is less a repeat of the financial crisis and more a signal that the post-pandemic buffer many families relied on has run its course.
segments.tr: डिफ़ॉल्ट डेटा जो सुझाव देता है वह वित्तीय संकट का दोहराव कम है, बल्कि यह एक संकेत अधिक है कि महामारी के बाद का बफर जिस पर कई परिवार निर्भर थे, वह समाप्त हो चुका है।

segments.src: ## Why Lenders and Policymakers Are Watching Closely
segments.tr: ## ऋणदाता और नीति निर्माता बारीकी से नज़र क्यों रख रहे हैं

segments.src: For banks and card issuers, rising delinquencies typically translate into higher loss provisions, which can lead to tighter underwriting standards down the road — fewer pre-approved offers, lower credit limits, and stricter income verification for new applicants.
segments.tr: बैंकों और कार्ड जारीकर्ताओं के लिए, बढ़ती चूक आमतौर पर उच्च हानि प्रावधानों (loss provisions) में बदल जाती है, जिससे आगे चलकर अधिक सख्त अंडरराइटिंग मानक लागू हो सकते हैं — जैसे कि कम प्री-अप्रूव्ड ऑफर, कम क्रेडिट सीमाएं और नए आवेदकों के लिए सख्त आय सत्यापन।

segments.src: That tightening, in turn, can make it harder for exactly the borrowers who are struggling to access the short-term credit they might need.
segments.tr: बदले में, वह सख्ती ठीक उन्हीं उधारकर्ताओं के लिए आवश्यक अल्पकालिक क्रेडिट तक पहुंचना कठिन बना सकती है जो संघर्ष कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: For the Federal Reserve and other policymakers, consumer credit health is one more data point in the broader debate about how long borrowing costs should stay elevated.
segments.tr: फेडरल रिजर्व और अन्य नीति निर्माताओं के लिए, उपभोक्ता क्रेडिट स्वास्थ्य इस व्यापक बहस में एक और डेटा बिंदु है कि उधार लेने की लागत को कब तक ऊंचा रखा जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: A steady rise in serious delinquency rates adds weight to the argument that current rate levels are squeezing households more than aggregate spending figures alone might suggest, even as those same spending figures have kept the broader economy looking resilient on the surface.
segments.tr: गंभीर डिफ़ॉल्ट दरों में लगातार वृद्धि इस तर्क को बल देती है कि मौजूदा ब्याज दर स्तर परिवारों पर उससे कहीं अधिक दबाव डाल रहे हैं जितना कि केवल कुल खर्च के आंकड़े सुझाव दे सकते हैं, भले ही उन्हीं खर्च के आंकड़ों ने व्यापक अर्थव्यवस्था को सतह पर लचीला बनाए रखा हो।

segments.src: ## What Households Can Take From This
segments.tr: ## परिवार इससे क्या सबक ले सकते हैं

segments.src: For individual consumers, the practical takeaway is less about the headline number and more about the trend line underneath it.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत उपभोक्ताओं के लिए, व्यावहारिक निष्कर्ष मुख्य आंकड़े के बारे में कम और उसके नीचे की प्रवृत्ति रेखा के बारे में अधिक है।

segments.src: A few points worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: ध्यान रखने योग्य कुछ बातें:

segments.src: - **Revolving balances compound quickly.** With average card interest rates still sitting well into the double digits, carrying a balance month to month is one of the most expensive ways to bridge a budget shortfall.
segments.tr: - **रिवॉल्विंग बकाया राशि तेजी से बढ़ती है।** औसत कार्ड ब्याज दरों के अभी भी दो अंकों में अच्छी तरह बने रहने के कारण, महीने-दर-महीने बकाया रखना बजट की कमी को पूरा करने का सबसे महंगा तरीका है।

segments.src: - **Minimum payments are a trap, not a plan.** Paying only the minimum can stretch a manageable balance into years of interest charges.
segments.tr: - **न्यूनतम भुगतान एक जाल है, योजना नहीं।** केवल न्यूनतम भुगतान करने से एक प्रबंधनीय बकाया राशि भी वर्षों के ब्याज शुल्कों में बदल सकती है।

segments.src: - **Early conversations with lenders help.** Card issuers often have hardship programs, temporary rate reductions, or modified payment plans available — but usually only for customers who reach out before an account goes seriously delinquent.
segments.tr: - **ऋणदाताओं के साथ जल्द बातचीत करने से मदद मिलती है।** कार्ड जारीकर्ताओं के पास अक्सर कठिनाई कार्यक्रम (hardship programs), अस्थायी दर में कटौती, या संशोधित भुगतान योजनाएं उपलब्ध होती हैं — लेकिन आमतौर पर केवल उन ग्राहकों के लिए जो खाता गंभीर रूप से डिफ़ॉल्ट होने से पहले संपर्क करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Rebuilding a buffer matters more than ever.** Even a small emergency fund can prevent a single unexpected expense from turning into a new credit card balance that lingers for months.
segments.tr: - **एक बफर का पुनर्निर्माण पहले से कहीं अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है।** एक छोटा सा आपातकालीन कोष भी किसी एक अप्रत्याशित खर्च को महीनों तक रहने वाले नए क्रेडिट कार्ड बकाया में बदलने से रोक सकता है।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: Delinquency statistics are backward-looking by nature — they describe bills that are already overdue rather than predicting what comes next.
segments.tr: डिफ़ॉल्ट के आंकड़े स्वभाव से अतीत को देखने वाले होते हैं — वे आगे क्या होने वाला है इसकी भविष्यवाणी करने के बजाय उन बिलों का वर्णन करते हैं जो पहले से ही अतिदेय हैं।

segments.src: But as a leading indicator of household financial stress, a 16-year high is not a number to shrug off.
segments.tr: लेकिन घरेलू वित्तीय तनाव के एक प्रमुख संकेतक के रूप में, 16 साल का उच्चतम स्तर कोई ऐसा आंकड़ा नहीं है जिसे नजरअंदाज किया जा सके।

segments.src: It suggests that beneath a labor market and stock market that have generally held up, a meaningful slice of American households is quietly falling behind, one credit card statement at a time.
segments.tr: यह सुझाव देता है कि आमतौर पर टिके रहने वाले श्रम बाजार और शेयर बाजार के नीचे, अमेरिकी परिवारों का एक बड़ा हिस्सा चुपचाप पिछड़ रहा है, एक समय में एक क्रेडिट कार्ड विवरण के साथ।

segments.src: Whether this marks a temporary adjustment as pandemic-era savings normalize, or the early stage of a more persistent affordability crunch, will likely depend on what happens next with inflation, interest rates, and hiring.

es.title: 13.1% y un máximo de 16 años: lo que revelan las crecientes morosidades de tarjetas de crédito sobre los hogares presionados

segments.src: ## A Warning Light on the Household Dashboard
segments.tr: ## Una luz de advertencia en el panel de los hogares

segments.src: A single statistic tends to cut through the noise of economic data releases, and this quarter it's this one: the share of credit card balances that are seriously delinquent — payments overdue by 90 days or more — has climbed to roughly 13.1%, the highest level recorded since the aftermath of the Great Recession.
segments.tr: Una sola estadística tiende a cortar el ruido de las publicaciones de datos económicos, y este trimestre es esta: la proporción de saldos de tarjetas de crédito que están seriamente en mora —pagos atrasados por 90 días o más— ha subido a aproximadamente el 13.1%, el nivel más alto registrado desde las secuelas de la Gran Recesión.

segments.src: For a metric that spent much of the 2010s trending quietly downward, a jump like this is hard to wave away as statistical noise.
segments.tr: Para una métrica que pasó gran parte de la década de 2010 tendiendo silenciosamente a la baja, un salto como este es difícil de descartar como ruido estadístico.

segments.src: Delinquency data doesn't grab headlines the way a jobs report or an inflation print does, but economists watch it closely for a reason.
segments.tr: Los datos de morosidad no acaparan los titulares de la manera en que lo hace un informe de empleo o una lectura de inflación, pero los economistas los observan de cerca por una razón.

segments.src: Credit cards are typically the last bill a household stops paying, after the mortgage, the car loan, and utilities.
segments.tr: Las tarjetas de crédito son típicamente la última factura que un hogar deja de pagar, después de la hipoteca, el préstamo para automóvil y los servicios públicos.

segments.src: When delinquencies rise here first and fastest, it's often a sign that the cushion beneath consumer spending is thinning out.
segments.tr: Cuando la morosidad aumenta aquí primero y más rápido, a menudo es una señal de que el colchón debajo del gasto del consumidor se está adelgazando.

segments.src: ## From Savings Cushion to Credit Dependence
segments.tr: ## Del colchón de ahorros a la dependencia del crédito

segments.src: During the pandemic years, stimulus payments, enhanced unemployment benefits, and reduced spending on travel and dining left many households with unusually large savings buffers.
segments.tr: Durante los años de la pandemia, los pagos de estímulo, los beneficios de desempleo mejorados y la reducción del gasto en viajes y cenas dejaron a muchos hogares con reservas de ahorro inusualmente grandes.

segments.src: That excess savings pile acted as a shock absorber, letting families ride out early bouts of inflation without leaning too hard on credit.
segments.tr: Esa pila de ahorros excesivos actuó como un amortiguador, permitiendo a las familias superar los primeros brotes de inflación sin apoyarse demasiado en el crédito.

segments.src: That cushion has now largely been spent down.
segments.tr: Ese colchón ya se ha gastado en gran medida.

segments.src: As it shrinks, more everyday costs — groceries, utility bills, insurance premiums, childcare — are increasingly being financed on revolving credit rather than paid for out of cash flow.
segments.tr: A medida que se reduce, más costos cotidianos —abacería, facturas de servicios públicos, primas de seguros, cuidado infantil— se financian cada vez más con crédito revolvente en lugar de pagarse con el flujo de caja.

segments.src: That shift shows up doubly in the data: total credit card balances have kept climbing to record highs even as interest rates on that debt remain elevated, meaning households are borrowing more at the exact moment borrowing has become more expensive.
segments.tr: Ese cambio se muestra doblemente en los datos: los saldos totales de las tarjetas de crédito han seguido subiendo a máximos históricos incluso cuando las tasas de interés de esa deuda se mantienen elevadas, lo que significa que los hogares están pidiendo más prestado en el momento exacto en que pedir prestado se ha vuelto más caro.

segments.src: ## Who Is Feeling the Squeeze Most
segments.tr: ## Quiénes están sintiendo más la presión

segments.src: The pain isn't distributed evenly.
segments.tr: El dolor no se distribuye de manera uniforme.

segments.src: Delinquency increases have been concentrated among younger borrowers and lower-income households, groups with thinner savings and less flexibility to absorb price shocks in the first place.
segments.tr: Los aumentos en la morosidad se han concentrado entre los prestatarios más jóvenes y los hogares de menores ingresos, grupos con ahorros más delgados y menos flexibilidad para absorber los choques de precios en primer lugar.

segments.src: Auto loans and, to a lesser extent, personal loans have shown similar stress, suggesting this isn't a phenomenon isolated to plastic — it's a broader story about stretched household budgets.
segments.tr: Los préstamos para automóviles y, en menor medida, los préstamos personales han mostrado un estrés similar, lo que sugiere que esto no es un fenómeno aislado del plástico, sino una historia más amplia sobre presupuestos familiares ajustados.

segments.src: At the same time, it's worth resisting the temptation to read a single indicator as proof of an imminent crisis.
segments.tr: Al mismo tiempo, vale la pena resistir la tentación de leer un solo indicador como prueba de una crisis inminente.

segments.src: Aggregate household debt as a share of income remains far below the levels seen just before 2008, and the labor market, while cooling, has not deteriorated sharply.
segments.tr: La deuda agregada de los hogares como porcentaje de los ingresos sigue estando muy por debajo de los niveles vistos justo antes de 2008, y el mercado laboral, aunque se está enfriando, no se ha deteriorado bruscamente.

segments.src: What the delinquency data suggests is less a repeat of the financial crisis and more a signal that the post-pandemic buffer many families relied on has run its course.
segments.tr: Lo que sugieren los datos de morosidad es menos una repetición de la crisis financiera y más una señal de que el amortiguador postpandemia en el que confiaban muchas familias ha llegado a su fin.

segments.src: ## Why Lenders and Policymakers Are Watching Closely
segments.tr: ## Por qué los prestamistas y los responsables políticos están observando de cerca

segments.src: For banks and card issuers, rising delinquencies typically translate into higher loss provisions, which can lead to tighter underwriting standards down the road — fewer pre-approved offers, lower credit limits, and stricter income verification for new applicants.
segments.tr: Para los bancos y emisores de tarjetas, el aumento de la morosidad generalmente se traduce en mayores provisiones para pérdidas, lo que puede llevar a estándares de suscripción más estrictos en el futuro: menos ofertas preaprobadas, límites de crédito más bajos y una verificación de ingresos más estricta para los nuevos solicitantes.

segments.src: That tightening, in turn, can make it harder for exactly the borrowers who are struggling to access the short-term credit they might need.
segments.tr: Ese endurecimiento, a su vez, puede dificultar precisamente que los prestatarios que están luchando accedan al crédito a corto plazo que puedan necesitar.

segments.src: For the Federal Reserve and other policymakers, consumer credit health is one more data point in the broader debate about how long borrowing costs should stay elevated.
segments.tr: Para la Reserva Federal y otros responsables políticos, la salud del crédito al consumo es un dato más en el debate más amplio sobre cuánto tiempo deben mantenerse elevados los costos de endeudamiento.

segments.src: A steady rise in serious delinquency rates adds weight to the argument that current rate levels are squeezing households more than aggregate spending figures alone might suggest, even as those same spending figures have kept the broader economy looking resilient on the surface.
segments.tr: Un aumento constante en las tasas de morosidad grave añade peso al argumento de que los niveles actuales de tasas están presionando a los hogares más de lo que las cifras de gasto agregado por sí solas podrían sugerir, incluso cuando esas mismas cifras de gasto han mantenido a la economía en general con un aspecto resiliente en la superficie.

segments.src: ## What Households Can Take From This
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden sacar los hogares de esto

segments.src: For individual consumers, the practical takeaway is less about the headline number and more about the trend line underneath it.
segments.tr: Para los consumidores individuales, la conclusión práctica es menos sobre el número principal y más sobre la línea de tendencia debajo de él.

segments.src: A few points worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Algunos puntos que vale la pena tener en cuenta:

segments.src: - **Revolving balances compound quickly.** With average card interest rates still sitting well into the double digits, carrying a balance month to month is one of the most expensive ways to bridge a budget shortfall.
segments.tr: - **Los saldos revolventes se acumulan rápidamente.** Con las tasas de interés promedio de las tarjetas aún en los dos dígitos, llevar un saldo mes a mes es una de las formas más caras de salvar un déficit presupuestario.

segments.src: - **Minimum payments are a trap, not a plan.** Paying only the minimum can stretch a manageable balance into years of interest charges.
segments.tr: - **Los pagos mínimos son una trampa, no un plan.** Pagar solo el mínimo puede extender un saldo manejable a años de cargos por intereses.

segments.src: - **Early conversations with lenders help.** Card issuers often have hardship programs, temporary rate reductions, or modified payment plans available — but usually only for customers who reach out before an account goes seriously delinquent.
segments.tr: - **Las conversaciones tempranas con los prestamistas ayudan.** Los emisores de tarjetas a menudo tienen programas de dificultades, reducciones temporales de tasas o planes de pago modificados disponibles, pero por lo general solo para los clientes que se comunican antes de que una cuenta caiga en mora grave.

segments.src: - **Rebuilding a buffer matters more than ever.** Even a small emergency fund can prevent a single unexpected expense from turning into a new credit card balance that lingers for months.
segments.tr: - **Reconstruir un colchón importa más que nunca.** Incluso un fondo de emergencia pequeño puede evitar que un solo gasto inesperado se convierta en un nuevo saldo de tarjeta de crédito que persista durante meses.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## El panorama general

segments.src: Delinquency statistics are backward-looking by nature — they describe bills that are already overdue rather than predicting what comes next.
segments.tr: Las estadísticas de morosidad son retrospectivas por naturaleza: describen facturas que ya están vencidas en lugar de predecir lo que viene después.

segments.src: But as a leading indicator of household financial stress, a 16-year high is not a number to shrug off.
segments.tr: Pero como indicador principal de estrés financiero en los hogares, un máximo de 16 años no es un número para ignorar.

segments.src: It suggests that beneath a labor market and stock market that have generally held up, a meaningful slice of American households is quietly falling behind, one credit card statement at a time.
segments.tr: Sugiere que debajo de un mercado laboral y un mercado de valores que generalmente se han mantenido, una porción significativa de los hogares estadounidenses se está quedando atrás silenciosamente, un estado de cuenta de tarjeta de crédito a la vez.

segments.src: Whether this marks a temporary adjustment as pandemic-era savings normalize, or the early stage of a more persistent affordability crunch, will likely depend on what happens next with inflation, interest rates, and hiring.
segments.tr: Si esto marca un ajuste temporal a medida que los ahorros de la era de la pandemia se normalizan, o la etapa inicial de una crisis de asequibilidad más persistente, probablemente dependerá de lo que suceda a continuación con la inflación, las tasas de interés y la contratación.

segments.src: Until then, the delinquency rate is one of the clearest windows available into how ordinary families are actually managing — or struggling to manage — their monthly budgets.
segments.tr: Hasta entonces, la tasa de morosidad es una de las ventanas más claras disponibles para ver cómo las familias comunes realmente están manejando —o luchando por manejar— sus presupuestos mensuales.

segments.tr: سواء كان هذا يمثل تعديلا مؤقتا حيث يتم تطبيع مدخرات عصر الوباء، أو المرحلة المبكرة من أزمة قدرة تحمل أكثر استدامة، فسوف يعتمد على الأرجح على ما يحدث بعد ذلك مع التضخم، وأسعار الفائدة، والتوظيف.

segments.src: Until then, the delinquency rate is one of the clearest windows available into how ordinary families are actually managing — or struggling to manage — their monthly budgets.
segments.tr: حتى ذلك الحين، يعد معدل التخلف عن السداد أحد أوضح النوافذ المتاحة حول كيفية إدارة العائلات العادية في الواقع — أو كفاحها لإدارة — ميزانياتها الشهرية.

fr.title: 13,1 % et un plus haut en 16 ans : ce que la hausse des impayés de cartes de crédit révèle sur les ménages sous pression

segments.src: ## A Warning Light on the Household Dashboard
segments.tr: ## Un voyant d'alerte sur le tableau de bord des ménages

segments.src: A single statistic tends to cut through the noise of economic data releases, and this quarter it's this one: the share of credit card balances that are seriously delinquent — payments overdue by 90 days or more — has climbed to roughly 13.1%, the highest level recorded since the aftermath of the Great Recession.
segments.tr: Une seule statistique a tendance à percer le bruit des publications de données économiques, et ce trimestre, c'est celle-ci : la part des soldes de cartes de crédit en situation de défaut grave — paiements en retard de 90 jours ou plus — a grimpé à environ 13,1 %, le niveau le plus élevé enregistré depuis les conséquences de la Grande Récession.

segments.src: For a metric that spent much of the 2010s trending quietly downward, a jump like this is hard to wave away as statistical noise.
segments.tr: Pour un indicateur qui a passé une grande partie des années 2010 à baisser discrètement, un tel bond est difficile à écarter comme un simple bruit statistique.

segments.src: Delinquency data doesn't grab headlines the way a jobs report or an inflation print does, but economists watch it closely for a reason.
segments.tr: Les données sur les impayés ne font pas la une des journaux comme le rapport sur l'emploi ou les chiffres de l'inflation, mais les économistes les surveillent de près pour une bonne raison.

segments.src: Credit cards are typically the last bill a household stops paying, after the mortgage, the car loan, and utilities.
segments.tr: Les cartes de crédit sont généralement la dernière facture qu'un ménage cesse de payer, après le prêt immobilier, le crédit auto et les services publics.

segments.src: When delinquencies rise here first and fastest, it's often a sign that the cushion beneath consumer spending is thinning out.
segments.tr: Lorsque les impayés augmentent ici en premier et le plus rapidement, c'est souvent le signe que le coussin financier sous les dépenses de consommation s'amincit.

segments.src: ## From Savings Cushion to Credit Dependence
segments.tr: ## Du coussin d'épargne à la dépendance au crédit

segments.src: During the pandemic years, stimulus payments, enhanced unemployment benefits, and reduced spending on travel and dining left many households with unusually large savings buffers.
segments.tr: Pendant les années de pandémie, les paiements de relance, les allocations chômage améliorées et la réduction des dépenses de voyage et de restauration ont laissé de nombreux ménages avec des réserves d'épargne inhabituellement importantes.

segments.src: That excess savings pile acted as a shock absorber, letting families ride out early bouts of inflation without leaning too hard on credit.
segments.tr: Ce surplus d'épargne a agi comme un amortisseur, permettant aux familles de traverser les premières poussées d'inflation sans trop dépendre du crédit.

segments.src: That cushion has now largely been spent down.
segments.tr: Ce coussin a maintenant été largement épuisé.

segments.src: As it shrinks, more everyday costs — groceries, utility bills, insurance premiums, childcare — are increasingly being financed on revolving credit rather than paid for out of cash flow.
segments.tr: À mesure qu'il rétrécit, davantage de coûts quotidiens — épicerie, factures de services publics, primes d'assurance, garde d'enfants — sont de plus en plus financés par du crédit renouvelable plutôt que payés par les flux de trésorerie.

segments.src: That shift shows up doubly in the data: total credit card balances have kept climbing to record highs even as interest rates on that debt remain elevated, meaning households are borrowing more at the exact moment borrowing has become more expensive.
segments.tr: Ce changement apparaît doublement dans les données : le total des soldes de cartes de crédit a continué de grimper vers des sommets records, même si les taux d'intérêt sur cette dette restent élevés, ce qui signifie que les ménages empruntent davantage au moment précis où emprunter est devenu plus coûteux.

segments.src: ## Who Is Feeling the Squeeze Most
segments.tr: ## Qui subit le plus la pression

segments.src: The pain isn't distributed evenly.
segments.tr: La douleur n'est pas répartie uniformément.

segments.src: Delinquency increases have been concentrated among younger borrowers and lower-income households, groups with thinner savings and less flexibility to absorb price shocks in the first place.
segments.tr: Les augmentations des impayés se sont concentrées parmi les emprunteurs plus jeunes et les ménages à faible revenu, des groupes disposant d'une épargne plus mince et moins de flexibilité pour absorber les chocs de prix en premier lieu.

segments.src: Auto loans and, to a lesser extent, personal loans have shown similar stress, suggesting this isn't a phenomenon isolated to plastic — it's a broader story about stretched household budgets.
segments.tr: Les prêts automobiles et, dans une moindre mesure, les prêts personnels ont montré un stress similaire, suggérant qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un phénomène isolé à la carte de crédit — c'est une histoire plus large sur les budgets des ménages tendus.

segments.src: At the same time, it's worth resisting the temptation to read a single indicator as proof of an imminent crisis.
segments.tr: En même temps, il vaut la peine de résister à la tentation de lire un seul indicateur comme la preuve d'une crise imminente.

segments.src: Aggregate household debt as a share of income remains far below the levels seen just before 2008, and the labor market, while cooling, has not deteriorated sharply.
segments.tr: La dette totale des ménages en pourcentage du revenu reste bien inférieure aux niveaux observés juste avant 2008, et le marché du travail, bien qu'en refroidissement, ne s'est pas fortement détérioré.

segments.src: What the delinquency data suggests is less a repeat of the financial crisis and more a signal that the post-pandemic buffer many families relied on has run its course.
segments.tr: Ce que suggèrent les données sur les impayés, ce n'est pas tant une répétition de la crise financière qu'un signal que le tampon post-pandémique sur lequel de nombreuses familles comptaient a fait son temps.

segments.src: ## Why Lenders and Policymakers Are Watching Closely
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les prêteurs et les décideurs surveillent de près

segments.src: For banks and card issuers, rising delinquencies typically translate into higher loss provisions, which can lead to tighter underwriting standards down the road — fewer pre-approved offers, lower credit limits, and stricter income verification for new applicants.
segments.tr: Pour les banques et les émetteurs de cartes, la hausse des impayés se traduit généralement par des provisions pour pertes plus élevées, ce qui peut conduire à des normes de souscription plus strictes à l'avenir — moins d'offres pré-approuvées, des limites de crédit plus basses et une vérification des revenus plus stricte pour les nouveaux demandeurs.

segments.src: That tightening, in turn, can make it harder for exactly the borrowers who are struggling to access the short-term credit they might need.
segments.tr: Ce resserrement, à son tour, peut rendre plus difficile pour les emprunteurs qui sont précisément en difficulté d'accéder au crédit à court terme dont ils pourraient avoir besoin.

segments.src: For the Federal Reserve and other policymakers, consumer credit health is one more data point in the broader debate about how long borrowing costs should stay elevated.
segments.tr: Pour la Réserve fédérale et les autres décideurs, la santé du crédit à la consommation est un point de données supplémentaire dans le débat plus large sur la durée pendant laquelle les coûts d'emprunt doivent rester élevés.

segments.src: A steady rise in serious delinquency rates adds weight to the argument that current rate levels are squeezing households more than aggregate spending figures alone might suggest, even as those same spending figures have kept the broader economy looking resilient on the surface.
segments.tr: Une hausse constante des taux d'impayés graves renforce l'argument selon lequel les niveaux de taux actuels pèsent sur les ménages plus que les chiffres globaux des dépenses ne pourraient le suggérer, même si ces mêmes chiffres de dépenses ont maintenu l'économie globale dans une apparence de résilience en surface.

segments.src: ## What Households Can Take From This
segments.tr: ## Ce que les ménages peuvent en retenir

segments.src: For individual consumers, the practical takeaway is less about the headline number and more about the trend line underneath it.
segments.tr: Pour les consommateurs individuels, la leçon pratique concerne moins le chiffre à la une que la tendance sous-jacente.

segments.src: A few points worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Quelques points à garder à l'esprit :

segments.src: - **Revolving balances compound quickly.** With average card interest rates still sitting well into the double digits, carrying a balance month to month is one of the most expensive ways to bridge a budget shortfall.
segments.tr: - **Les soldes renouvelables se composent rapidement.** Avec des taux d'intérêt moyens sur les cartes toujours bien à deux chiffres, reporter un solde d'un mois à l'autre est l'un des moyens les plus coûteux de combler un déficit budgétaire.

segments.src: - **Minimum payments are a trap, not a plan.** Paying only the minimum can stretch a manageable balance into years of interest charges.
segments.tr: - **Les paiements minimums sont un piège, pas un plan.** Ne payer que le minimum peut transformer un solde gérable en années de frais d'intérêt.

segments.src: - **Early conversations with lenders help.** Card issuers often have hardship programs, temporary rate reductions, or modified payment plans available — but usually only for customers who reach out before an account goes seriously delinquent.
segments.tr: - **Les conversations précoces avec les prêteurs aident.** Les émetteurs de cartes ont souvent des programmes de difficulté, des réductions de taux temporaires ou des plans de paiement modifiés disponibles — mais généralement uniquement pour les clients qui contactent avant qu'un compte ne devienne gravement en défaut.

segments.src: - **Rebuilding a buffer matters more than ever.** Even a small emergency fund can prevent a single unexpected expense from turning into a new credit card balance that lingers for months.
segments.tr: - **Reconstituer un tampon est plus important que jamais.** Même un petit fonds d'urgence peut empêcher une dépense imprévue unique de se transformer en un nouveau solde de carte de crédit qui persiste pendant des mois.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## La vue d'ensemble

segments.src: Delinquency statistics are backward-looking by nature — they describe bills that are already overdue rather than predicting what comes next.
segments.tr: Les statistiques sur les impayés sont par nature tournées vers le passé — elles décrivent des factures déjà en retard plutôt que de prédire ce qui va suivre.

segments.src: But as a leading indicator of household financial stress, a 16-year high is not a number to shrug off.
segments.tr: Mais en tant qu'indicateur avancé du stress financier des ménages, un plus haut en 16 ans n'est pas un chiffre à ignorer.

segments.src: It suggests that beneath a labor market and stock market that have generally held up, a meaningful slice of American households is quietly falling behind, one credit card statement at a time.
segments.tr: Cela suggère que sous un marché du travail et un marché boursier qui ont généralement tenu bon, une part significative des ménages américains prend discrètement du retard, un relevé de carte de crédit à la fois.

segments.src: Whether this marks a temporary adjustment as pandemic-era savings normalize, or the early stage of a more persistent affordability crunch, will likely depend on what happens next with inflation, interest rates, and hiring.
segments.tr: Si cela marque un ajustement temporaire à mesure que l'épargne de l'ère pandémique se normalise, ou le début d'une crise d'abordabilité plus persistante, dépendra probablement de ce qui se passera ensuite avec l'inflation, les taux d'intérêt et l'embauche.

segments.src: Until then, the delinquency rate is one of the clearest windows available into how ordinary families are actually managing — or struggling to manage — their monthly budgets.
segments.tr: D'ici là, le taux d'impayés est l'une des fenêtres les plus claires disponibles sur la façon dont les familles ordinaires gèrent — ou luttent pour gérer — leurs budgets mensuels.

pt.title: 13,1% e a Máxima em 16 Anos: O que o Aumento da Inadimplência no Cartão de Crédito Revela Sobre as Famílias Pressionadas

segments.src: ## A Warning Light on the Household Dashboard
segments.tr: ## Um Sinal de Alerta no Painel das Famílias

segments.src: A single statistic tends to cut through the noise of economic data releases, and this quarter it's this one: the share of credit card balances that are seriously delinquent — payments overdue by 90 days or more — has climbed to roughly 13.1%, the highest level recorded since the aftermath of the Great Recession.
segments.tr: Uma única estatística costuma se destacar em meio ao ruído das divulgações de dados econômicos, e neste trimestre é esta: a parcela de saldos de cartões de crédito com inadimplência grave — pagamentos em atraso há 90 dias ou mais — subiu para cerca de 13,1%, o nível mais alto registrado desde o período posterior à Grande Recessão.

segments.src: For a metric that spent much of the 2010s trending quietly downward, a jump like this is hard to wave away as statistical noise.
segments.tr: Para uma métrica que passou grande parte da década de 2010 em uma tendência de queda silenciosa, um salto como esse é difícil de ser descartado como mero ruído estatístico.

segments.src: Delinquency data doesn't grab headlines the way a jobs report or an inflation print does, but economists watch it closely for a reason.
segments.tr: Os dados de inadimplência não ganham as manchetes da mesma forma que um relatório de empregos ou um índice de inflação, mas os economistas os acompanham de perto por um motivo.

segments.src: Credit cards are typically the last bill a household stops paying, after the mortgage, the car loan, and utilities.
segments.tr: Os cartões de crédito costumam ser a última conta que uma família deixa de pagar, depois da hipoteca, do financiamento do carro e dos serviços básicos.

segments.src: When delinquencies rise here first and fastest, it's often a sign that the cushion beneath consumer spending is thinning out.
segments.tr: Quando a inadimplência sobe primeiro e mais rápido aqui, geralmente é um sinal de que a folga financeira que sustenta os gastos dos consumidores está diminuindo.

segments.src: ## From Savings Cushion to Credit Dependence
segments.tr: ## Da Poupança de Reserva à Dependência do Crédito

segments.src: During the pandemic years, stimulus payments, enhanced unemployment benefits, and reduced spending on travel and dining left many households with unusually large savings buffers.
segments.tr: Durante os anos da pandemia, os pagamentos de estímulos, os benefícios de desemprego ampliados e a redução dos gastos com viagens e restaurantes deixaram muitas famílias com reservas de poupança excepcionalmente grandes.

segments.src: That excess savings pile acted as a shock absorber, letting families ride out early bouts of inflation without leaning too hard on credit.
segments.tr: Esse excesso de poupança funcionou como um amortecedor, permitindo que as famílias superassem as primeiras ondas de inflação sem depender excessivamente do crédito.

segments.src: That cushion has now largely been spent down.
segments.tr: Essa reserva agora foi, em grande parte, consumida.

segments.src: As it shrinks, more everyday costs — groceries, utility bills, insurance premiums, childcare — are increasingly being financed on revolving credit rather than paid for out of cash flow.
segments.tr: À medida que ela encolhe, mais custos do dia a dia — supermercado, contas de serviços básicos, prêmios de seguros, creche — estão sendo cada vez mais financiados no crédito rotativo, em vez de serem pagos com o fluxo de caixa.

segments.src: That shift shows up doubly in the data: total credit card balances have kept climbing to record highs even as interest rates on that debt remain elevated, meaning households are borrowing more at the exact moment borrowing has become more expensive.
segments.tr: Essa mudança aparece em dobro nos dados: os saldos totais de cartões de crédito continuam subindo para níveis recordes, mesmo com as taxas de juros dessa dívida permanecendo elevadas, o que significa que as famílias estão pegando mais empréstimos exatamente no momento em que tomar crédito se tornou mais caro.

segments.src: ## Who Is Feeling the Squeeze Most
segments.tr: ## Quem Está Sentindo Mais a Pressão

segments.src: The pain isn't distributed evenly.
segments.tr: A dor não está distribuída de forma uniforme.

segments.src: Delinquency increases have been concentrated among younger borrowers and lower-income households, groups with thinner savings and less flexibility to absorb price shocks in the first place.
segments.tr: Os aumentos de inadimplência concentraram-se entre os tomadores de empréstimo mais jovens e as famílias de menor renda, grupos com poupanças mais escassas e menos flexibilidade para absorver choques de preços em primeiro lugar.

segments.src: Auto loans and, to a lesser extent, personal loans have shown similar stress, suggesting this isn't a phenomenon isolated to plastic — it's a broader story about stretched household budgets.
segments.tr: Os financiamentos de veículos e, em menor escala, os empréstimos pessoais mostraram um estresse semelhante, sugerindo que este não é um fenômeno isolado ao cartão de plástico — é uma história mais ampla sobre orçamentos familiares sobrecarregados.

segments.src: At the same time, it's worth resisting the temptation to read a single indicator as proof of an imminent crisis.
segments.tr: Ao mesmo tempo, vale a pena resistir à tentação de interpretar um único indicador como prova de uma crise iminente.

segments.src: Aggregate household debt as a share of income remains far below the levels seen just before 2008, and the labor market, while cooling, has not deteriorated sharply.
segments.tr: A dívida familiar agregada como proporção da renda permanece muito abaixo dos níveis vistos pouco antes de 2008, e o mercado de trabalho, embora esteja esfriando, não se deteriorou drasticamente.

segments.src: What the delinquency data suggests is less a repeat of the financial crisis and more a signal that the post-pandemic buffer many families relied on has run its course.
segments.tr: O que os dados de inadimplência sugerem não é tanto uma repetição da crise financeira, mas sim um sinal de que a reserva pós-pandemia na qual muitas famílias confiavam chegou ao fim.

segments.src: ## Why Lenders and Policymakers Are Watching Closely
segments.tr: ## Por Que os Credores e Formuladores de Políticas Estão Acompanhando de Perto

segments.src: For banks and card issuers, rising delinquencies typically translate into higher loss provisions, which can lead to tighter underwriting standards down the road — fewer pre-approved offers, lower credit limits, and stricter income verification for new applicants.
segments.tr: Para os bancos e emissores de cartões, o aumento da inadimplência geralmente se traduz em maiores provisões para perdas, o que pode levar a critérios de concessão de crédito mais rígidos no futuro — menos ofertas pré-aprovadas, limites de crédito mais baixos e verificação de renda mais rigorosa para novos candidatos.

segments.src: That tightening, in turn, can make it harder for exactly the borrowers who are struggling to access the short-term credit they might need.
segments.tr: Esse aperto, por sua vez, pode dificultar o acesso ao crédito de curto prazo justamente para os tomadores que estão enfrentando dificuldades e que poderiam precisar dele.

segments.src: For the Federal Reserve and other policymakers, consumer credit health is one more data point in the broader debate about how long borrowing costs should stay elevated.
segments.tr: Para o Federal Reserve e outros formuladores de políticas, a saúde do crédito ao consumidor é mais um dado no debate mais amplo sobre por quanto tempo os custos dos empréstimos devem permanecer elevados.

segments.src: A steady rise in serious delinquency rates adds weight to the argument that current rate levels are squeezing households more than aggregate spending figures alone might suggest, even as those same spending figures have kept the broader economy looking resilient on the surface.
segments.tr: Um aumento constante nas taxas de inadimplência grave reforça o argumento de que os níveis atuais de juros estão pressionando as famílias mais do que os números agregados de gastos sozinhos poderiam sugerir, mesmo que esses mesmos números de gastos tenham mantido a economia em geral com uma aparência resiliente na superfície.

segments.src: ## What Households Can Take From This
segments.tr: ## O Que as Famílias Podem Tirar Disso

segments.src: For individual consumers, the practical takeaway is less about the headline number and more about the trend line underneath it.
segments.tr: Para os consumidores individuais, a lição prática tem menos a ver com o número principal e mais com a linha de tendência por trás dele.

segments.src: A few points worth keeping in mind:
segments.tr: Alguns pontos que vale a pena manter em mente:

segments.src: - **Revolving balances compound quickly.** With average card interest rates still sitting well into the double digits, carrying a balance month to month is one of the most expensive ways to bridge a budget shortfall.
segments.tr: - **Os saldos rotativos acumulam-se rapidamente.** Com as taxas médias de juros dos cartões ainda na casa dos dois dígitos, carregar um saldo devedor de mês para mês é uma das formas mais caras de cobrir um déficit orçamentário.

segments.src: - **Minimum payments are a trap, not a plan.** Paying only the minimum can stretch a manageable balance into years of interest charges.
segments.tr: - **Os pagamentos mínimos são uma armadilha, não um plano.** Pagar apenas o mínimo pode transformar um saldo administrável em anos de cobrança de juros.

segments.src: - **Early conversations with lenders help.** Card issuers often have hardship programs, temporary rate reductions, or modified payment plans available — but usually only for customers who reach out before an account goes seriously delinquent.
segments.tr: - **Conversas antecipadas com os credores ajudam.** Os emissores de cartões costumam ter programas de assistência, reduções temporárias de taxas ou planos de pagamento modificados disponíveis — mas geralmente apenas para clientes que entram em contato antes que a conta entre em inadimplência grave.

segments.src: - **Rebuilding a buffer matters more than ever.** Even a small emergency fund can prevent a single unexpected expense from turning into a new credit card balance that lingers for months.
segments.tr: - **Reconstruir uma reserva importa mais do que nunca.** Mesmo um pequeno fundo de emergência pode evitar que uma única despesa inesperada se transforme em um novo saldo de cartão de crédito que se arrasta por meses.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## O Cenário Amplo

segments.src: Delinquency statistics are backward-looking by nature — they describe bills that are already overdue rather than predicting what comes next.
segments.tr: As estatísticas de inadimplência são, por natureza, voltadas para o passado — elas descrevem contas que já estão atrasadas, em vez de prever o que vem a seguir.

segments.src: But as a leading indicator of household financial stress, a 16-year high is not a number to shrug off.
segments.tr: Mas, como um indicador antecedente do estresse financeiro das famílias, uma máxima de 16 anos não é um número para se ignorar.

segments.src: It suggests that beneath a labor market and stock market that have generally held up, a meaningful slice of American households is quietly falling behind, one credit card statement at a time.
segments.tr: Isso sugere que, por trás de um mercado de trabalho e de um mercado de ações que geralmente têm se sustentado, uma parcela significativa das famílias americanas está silenciosamente ficando para trás, uma fatura de cartão de crédito de cada vez.

segments.src: Whether this marks a temporary adjustment as pandemic-era savings normalize, or the early stage of a more persistent affordability crunch, will likely depend on what happens next with inflation, interest rates, and hiring.
segments.tr: Se isso marca um ajuste temporário à medida que as poupanças da era da pandemia se normalizam, ou o estágio inicial de uma crise de acessibilidade financeira mais persistente, provavelmente dependerá do que acontecer a seguir com a inflação, as taxas de juros e as contratações.

segments.src: Until then, the delinquency rate is one of the clearest windows available into how ordinary families are actually managing — or struggling to manage — their monthly budgets.
segments.tr: Até lá, a taxa de inadimplência é uma das janelas mais claras disponíveis para observar como as famílias comuns estão realmente gerenciando — ou lutando para gerenciar — seus orçamentos mensais.
